notes.title: Free update and discount coming today!
notes.notes:
Create and Share with the Editor Mode 
In addition to new puzzles, players can now take advantage of the editor mode. This powerful tool allows players to design their own puzzles, share them with the Linkito community, and explore over 500 user-generated levels already available. The editor mode offers players the opportunity to unleash their creativity and contribute to a growing library of unique challenges expanding the experience further after completing the single-player mode.

Innovative Real-World Connectivity 

The integration with real-world technology is one of the unique features that Linkito has to offer. Linkito supports connections with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, OSC, Twitch and more allowing players to create interactive experiences that bridge the digital and physical worlds. This feature opens up exciting new possibilities for personalized and immersive gameplay, such as making real-world puzzles, escape games, or even mini-games.

Challenge your brainpower with 15 new mathematical levels. Will you manage to crunch the numbers ?
